Update Z for Ordinal or Binary Data

Source: R/utils_z_update.R
update_Z_optimized.Rd

Dispatches Z updates using either Gaussian approximation or exact truncated normal sampling based on data characteristics

Usage

update_Z_optimized(R, Z, Theta, M, IR = NULL, family = "ordinal")

Arguments

R

Rank data array

Z

Current latent values

Theta

Current theta values

M

Mean array

IR

Rank indices (only needed for exact sampling)

family

Data family

Value

Updated Z array
